parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem: Carbon-14 is radioactive and decays by emission of $\beta^{-}$ particles.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Nuclei do not contain $\beta^{-}$ particles.

Explain the origin of the $\beta^{-}$ particle that is emitted from the nucleus during $\beta^{-}$ decay.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the change in the quark composition of a carbon-14 nucleus when it emits a $\beta^{-}$ particle.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Suggest why the $\beta^{-}$ particles are emitted with a range of different energies.
